subject: Tier freeze + burst bundle options — proposal and timing
messages:
From: Alexandra Cole <alex.cole@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Packaging question — temporary tier freeze + burst capacity

Hi Rachel,

Quick one from our side — Q4 usage spiked and our product team wants to avoid moving permanently to the next tier. Can we: 1) temporarily freeze our current tier for 3 months (keep feature set and seat counts as-is), and 2) add a billed burst bundle that gives us an extra 200k tokens/day during peak hours (Nov-Feb pattern) without changing our committed tier pricing?

We want to avoid a full upgrade and the procurement team is worried about ramping cost. Attached is our usage export for Q4 to show the pattern.

Main asks:
- Is a temporary tier freeze contractually possible?
- Can burst capacity be packaged as an add-on with separate commit/discounting?
- What would be the proration and the discount schedule for a 3-month bundle?

Thanks,
Alex
Alexandra Cole
Sr PM, Conversational AI
Clearline Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Cole <alex.cole@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question — temporary tier freeze + burst capacity

Alex — thanks for the data and the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes, we can support a temporary tier freeze and yes, we can offer a burst add-on as a metered/committed bundle.

I'll outline two paths below and attach a one-page comparison PDF. After you pick a path we can get procurement language and a DocuSign ready.

Option A — Temporary Tier Freeze + Metered Burst
- Freeze your current tier for 90 days. No feature removal; seats unchanged.
- Add a "Burst Block": prepaid 6M tokens (about 200k tokens/day over 90 days). Unused tokens roll forward to month+1 within the 90 days only.
- Pricing: Burst Block at 55% of standard on-demand token rate (volume discount for prepay). No change to base tier price.
- Proration: If executed mid-billing-cycle, base tier stays at current proration; Burst Block billed pro-rata for remaining days.

Option B — Temporary Tier Freeze + Reserved Burst with Discount Ladder
- Same freeze terms.
- Reserved burst pool with 3-tier discount: 20% discount for 3-month commit, 30% for 6-month, 40% for 12-month (applies to burst tokens only).
- If Clearline increases base tier during the freeze, we convert excess burst usage to metered overage at on-demand rates.

Questions:
- Do you need the burst available only in us-west region? (we can scope by region)
- Are you willing to prepay the 6M tokens for the 3-month window? That lets us offer the 55% figure above.

Looping in Ben (commercial) and Kimberly (finance/proration) for numbers and contract language. I can turn this into a quick amendment to your current SOW.

- Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question — temporary tier freeze + burst capacity

FW: Clearline request — pricing math below.

Quick calc (assume on-demand token $0.00003/token):
- On-demand cost for 6M tokens = $180
- Option A (55% of on-demand) = $99
- Option B (3-month reserved 20% discount) = $144 (if not prepaying — slightly more expensive but refundable credit if unused)
- If they prepay, we can invoice net-15 and offer 2% early-pay discount.

Notes for contract: we can include a one-time amendment that: 1) freezes features/seat counts; 2) adds a burst addendum; 3) includes end-of-freeze review and auto-rollback unless they elect to upgrade. Need legal to confirm rollback wording.

Markus — can you confirm whether we allow roll-forward of unused burst tokens beyond the 90 days (customer asked specifically)? My recollection is only within the billing window plus 30 days exception for service interruptions.

Ben
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jan 2028 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question — temporary tier freeze + burst capacity

Ben — confirmed: policy is unused prepaid burst tokens can be rolled forward up to 30 days after the end of the committed window, but not beyond. For exceptions (major outage with <99.9% availability) we make a case-by-case credit.

On proration specifics: we will invoice the burst on the amendment effective date pro-rata. If they terminate early, unused prepaid burst is refunded on a pro-rata basis minus a 5% administrative fee unless they upgrade to the higher tier (in which case we convert unused tokens to credit against the higher tier for the remainder of the term).

I'll draft the clause language for legal to review.

-Markus
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Cole <alex.cole@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 08:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question — temporary tier freeze + burst capacity

Alex — thanks for the patience. Based on usage and our commercial options we recommend Option A (prepaid Burst Block at 55% of on-demand) for the 3-month freeze window — lowest immediate cost and simplest contract. Summary attached and next steps below:

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm scope: us-west only? (you said most peak traffic is US west)
2) Confirm prepay authorization (procurement) — we'll issue amendment and DocuSign.
3) Legal & procurement sign-off target: 10 business days.

If procurement prefers the reserved ladder (Option B), we can run the 6-month vs 3-month pricing in the HubSpot quote.

Attaching the tier comparison and a draft amendment. I can get a DocuSign envelope out today if you confirm region & prepay.

Best,
Rachel
From: Alexandra Cole <alex.cole@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question — temporary tier freeze + burst capacity

Thanks Rachel — procurement confirmed we can prepay the 6M token Burst Block scoped to us-west and sign a 90-day amendment. Please send the DocuSign. Two small asks from procurement:
- Add a line about a single 30-day grace roll-forward for unused burst tokens.
- Include an explicit termination notice period of 15 days before the end of the 90-day freeze if either side wants the freeze to lapse earlier.

If you can include those in the amendment we'll approve and sign. 

Alex

Clearline Health
